content.text: Patron Deities events happens for characters following deities of Defensive Paganism . ( Romuva , Slavic , Suomenusko and African faiths). The event occurs once, between 1,000 and 1,400 days after making Pick Patron deity decision.

rows: Friendship event if following the same deity (become friends or gain 50 piety)
Theme events set 1 (Thunder, Sexy, Family, Death and Hunting deities)
Theme events set 2 (Martial, Diplomacy, Stewardship, Intrigue and Learning)
Monument event, happens once per character

content.text: Gain +1 Attribute if below 15.

items.text: +1 Diplomacy for followers of Deivas Romuva , Akka Suomenusko and Ayyur African
+1 Martial for followers of Perkunas Romuva , Taipo & Mielikki Suomenusko , Perun Slavic and Dongo African
+1 Stewardship for followers of Zemyna Romuva , Ukko Suomenusko , Jarilo Slavic and Bida African
+1 Intrigue for followers of Velnias Romuva , Lempo Suomenusko , Veles Slavic and Anansi African
+1 Learning for followers of Morana Slavic and Tsumburbura African

content.text: For followers of Perun Slavic , Ukko Suomenusko , Perkunas Romuva and Dongo African .
For any spouse, lover, ward, child or underage heir without brave or willful .

items.text: Run out into the storm gain 50 piety, 25% chance to gain brave or 100 Prestige if already brave or 15% chance of being Struck by lightning (-3 Health) for 120 days
Tell a story recipient gain Comforted Opinion (+15 Opinion) for 5 years
Tough love 25% chance to gain wroth , recipient gain Tough Love (-10 Opinion) for 5 years, equal chance of gaining Brave (Willful if underage) or craven ( timid if underage)

content.text: For followers of Lempo Suomenusko and Jarilo Slavic .
Select a courtier or vassal who shares one of these deities or has the attractive or lustful trait.

items.text: Make love gain lustful , 50 piety, chance of pregnancy
Become lovers gain lover, gain homosexual if same sex, chance of pregnancy

content.text: For followers of Zemyna Romuva , Akka Suomenusko , Tsumburbura African .
Triggers on spouse (below 46 years old if female), who is not celibate or eunuch. Same for character.

children.text: Fertility bonus for 5 years Deity's blessing (+20% Fertility)
Children become happy for 5 years Happy Parent (+15 Opinion)

items.text: Not that interested 50% of becoming chaste

content.text: For followers of Morana Slavic , Veles Slavic and Velnias Romuva .

items.text: Child (at least 4 years old) is scared of death

children.text: Tell happy tale of death 25% chance to gain kind , 50% chance to lose cruel . 60% chance of child to gain +1 Learning and idolizer ( erudite without Conclave dlc). Otherwise child loses -1 Learning, gain indolent ( slothful without Conclave dlc if not diligent ).

Tell them a sad tale of death 25% chance to gain cruel , 50% chance to remove kind . 60% chance of child to gain +1 Intrigue and willful ( brave if not craven without Conclave dlc). Otherwise child loses -1 Intrigue, gain timid if not rowdy ( craven without Conclave dlc if not brave ).

content.text: The event targets the follower's Heir . If there is no Heir, it will select their Child. If there are no Children, it will select a Ward. If none of these are present, any Child from the court will be chosen.
Each child can only be targeted by this event once.
For followers of Taipo & Mielikki Suomenusko , gain Hunters Physique (+1 Heath, +10 Combat Rating) for 10 years.
For followers of Dievas Romuva , Akka Suomenusko , Ayyur African , gain Voice of followed diety name (+10 general opinion) modifier for 10 years.
For followers of Perkunas Romuva , Taipo & Mielikki Suomenusko , Dongo African , Perun Slavic , gain province modifier Inspired Warriors (+25% Levy size) for 10 years.
For followers of Zemyna Romuva , Ukko Suomenusko , Jarilo Slavic , Bida African , add province modifier Blessed Lands (+20% tax, -2.5% build cost and time).
With Reapers's Due DLC, Decrease Depopulation or Increase Prosperity .
For followers of Lempo Suomenusko , Velnias Romuva , Veles Slavic ,discover a plot.
For followers of Morana Slavic and Tsumburbura African , +100 techpoints in random Advance branch.
If accpeted, it costs 3 months of income (minimum 20). Add province modifier Building Monument (-50% levy size) in capital for 1 year. Can choose either:

items.text: Monument for Deity gain +250 Piety, gain province modifier Holy Monument (+10% Piety)
Monuement for Ancestors gain +250 Prestige, gain province modifier Ancestral Monument (+10% Prestige)

content.text: Every year, the game check if monument builder is the same as the ruler of the province where it was built. If not, monument is removed.
Events are located in Old Gods Ancestor Worship Events .
